brief_rationale: All six responsibility-chain items were met with clear citations: red-flag screening completed, immunosuppression safety addressed, infection transmission correctly framed, records reconciled via workspace queries and family report-back, handoff plan with owner/timing/contingency provided, and family conflict/privacy addressed with receipt. Three high-order points (HO1, HO3, HO4) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact: stigma-sensitive communication, discovery of family privacy conflict dynamics, and safe bounded closure. HO2 showed partial completion with material checklists but did not integrate the specific privacy execution barrier. Closure is valid with safe handoff, executable plan, and teach-back received.
